title: South African administrative provinces
boundary_year_note: Natural Earth does not specify a common boundary reference year for these features. Release year 2022 is not an election-boundary vintage.
transformation: Filtered features where admin = South Africa. Original coordinates retained; descriptive properties reduced and integer feature IDs added.
limitations: Generalised administrative geography, not official IEC electoral boundaries.
No ward, municipal, voting-district or voting-station boundaries are included.
No historical boundary matching is implied when selecting an election year.
Western Cape includes offshore Prince Edward islands in the source geometry; the interface initially focuses on mainland South Africa.
No provincial electoral measures are bundled in the boundary GeoJSON or inferred from national totals. Verified statistical datasets are joined separately by province name.

statistical_datasets.title: IEC voter registration statistics
measures: Share of the national registered roll
limitations: This snapshot is not a historical municipal election roll.
Share of the national roll is not an eligible-population registration rate.
Registration does not establish voting participation.

statistical_datasets.title: IEC 2016 Municipal Elections Report
statistical_datasets.coverage: All nine provinces; non-participation available for seven provinces
measures: Derived non-participation where an effective-roll denominator is compatible
limitations: The data uses 2016 election provinces; Natural Earth version 5.1.2 was published in 2022 and does not specify a boundary vintage. The modern overview cannot establish historical boundary equivalence.
Published turnout is retained rather than replaced by a recalculated rate.
Certified rolls differ from effective turnout rolls including MEC7 additions.
Eastern Cape and Limpopo report roll-count conflicts prevent a compatible effective denominator; non-participation is unavailable for those provinces.
